nodes.title: Countable dense sets as preimages under entire functions

nodes.summary: Let $f$ and $g$ be entire functions with $f(z)^3 + g(z)^3 = 1$ for every $z \in \mathbb{C}$. Then $f$ and $g$ are constant.
nodes.title: Entire solutions of the Fermat cubic are constant

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be entire with $f(s + 1) = f(s)$ for all $s \in \mathbb{C}$, and suppose there is a real constant $C$ such that $|f(s)| \le C e^{|\operatorname{Im} s|}$ for every $s$ with $0 \le \operatorname{Re} s \le 1$. Then $f$ is constant.
nodes.title: A $1$-periodic entire function bounded by $C e^{|\operatorname{Im} s|}$ is constant

nodes.summary: If $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ is entire and injective, then there are $a, b \in \mathbb{C}$ with $a \ne 0$ such that $f(z) = az + b$ for all $z \in \mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: Injective entire functions are affine

nodes.summary: There is a sequence $(a_k)_{k \ge 0}$ of complex numbers, not all zero, such that the power series $\sum_{k=0}^{\infty} a_k z^k$ converges absolutely for every $z \in \mathbb{C}$ and its sum vanishes at infinitely many points $z \in \mathbb{C}$.
nodes.title: A nonzero entire power series with infinitely many zeros
Growth of entire functions along continua
Spherical area and valence of meromorphic functions

nodes.summary: Let $S \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ be a closed set all of whose points are isolated: for each $z \in S$ there is $\varepsilon > 0$ such that no point $w \ne z$ of $S$ satisfies $|w - z| < \varepsilon$. Then there is an entire function $f$ whose zeros are exactly the points of $S$, all of them simple: $f'(z) \ne 0$ for every $z \in S$.
nodes.title: Weierstrass theorem on prescribed simple zeros
Zeros and ones of entire functions on lines
Zeros of the entire function 1 + Σ (z/n)ⁿ

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
